chef: Righto, listen up. The market's calm — crypto barely moved, nobody's panicking. Robots and rockets are what's cooking; everything else is garnish tonight. I've plated 3 Aussie picks and 3 from overseas. One of them (PLTR) already bolted 29% — you're late, don't chase the bus, wait for it to stop.
hotTags: 🥇 Gold hot · 🛡️ Defence hot · 🤖 AI on fire

picks.name: Monadelphous
picks.plain: Just landed a $200m BHP contract but the shares have barely twitched. That's the whole game — good news, price hasn't caught up yet.
picks.chefTake: Think of MND as the tradie who just landed a massive job but hasn't bragged about it at the pub yet. Contract's signed, money's coming, share price is still sitting there like nothing happened. That gap is the whole opportunity. Not a fireworks stock — more a reliable Sunday roast — but you want to be seated before the room smells it.
catalysts: Just won a ~$200m contract from BHP — real money, confirmed
Shares up only +1.07% — the good news isn't priced in yet
Trading above its 50-day AND 200-day average (healthy trend)
Mining & engineering work booming with the resources rally
picks.risk: Double-check the contract is actually today-dated before you jump in. It's a big, steady company — moves are measured, not explosive.

picks.name: Pinnacle
picks.plain: Cracking result, jumped 8%. Only catch — it's a bit hot right now. Let it cool and buy the pullback near A$18.50.
picks.chefTake: PNI just served a cracker and the whole room clapped (+8%). Trouble is, everyone's now queuing. When a dish is this hot you don't burn your mouth — you wait for it to cool to about A$18.50, then tuck in. Cracking business; just don't pay the 'straight out of the oven' premium.
catalysts: Big earnings result — money flooding into their funds
Two separate news sources flagged it (rare = strong signal)
Well above both its trend lines — momentum leader
Standing tall while rival fund managers cop 'sell' calls
picks.risk: It's run hard already (RSI nearly 69). Chasing it here means paying full menu price. Be patient for the pullback.

runnerUp.name: Light & Wonder
runnerUp.line: Earnings beat, +6.5% — the other multi-source Aussie result, and less overheated than PNI.

picks.name: Electro Optic
picks.plain: Lasers and drone-killers. AUKUS money is a multi-year tide. It's cheap vs its average — a patient buy, not a sprint.
picks.chefTake: EOS is the slow-cooked brisket. Lasers, drone-zappers, the works — and governments are throwing AUKUS money at exactly this menu for years to come. Right now it's marked down below its usual price, which is precisely when you load the plate. Bring patience, not a stopwatch.
catalysts: Fresh 'Buy' call from a broker — analyst conviction
Makes lasers & drone-killers — exactly what AUKUS funds
Counter-drone demand rising with global conflict
Cheap vs its own average — a recovery setup
picks.risk: Defence contracts can be slow and lumpy. It's below its average price — make sure it's turning up before you back the truck.

picks.name: Kratos Defense
picks.plain: Drones and target systems. A big broker just flipped bullish ($75 target) and 25 analysts say buy, zero say sell. That's a wall.
picks.chefTake: Kratos makes the drones AND the targets you shoot drones at — very on-theme. A big broker just banged the table ($75) and literally nobody on Wall Street is saying sell. That's about as close to a green light as this game hands out. Fresh off the pass, not overcooked yet.
catalysts: A major broker just upgraded it (target $75, ~45% up)
25 analysts say buy, ZERO say sell — a wall of support
Rides the same defence wave as our Aussie picks
Up 5% today with room before it's overheated
picks.risk: Still below its long-term average — the bigger downtrend isn't fully repaired. Defence orders can also be lumpy quarter to quarter.

picks.name: Palantir
picks.plain: Monster earnings, best day in 2 years. But it's up 29% today — chasing that is how you get burned. Wait for the hangover dip near $150.
picks.chefTake: PLTR just went nuclear (+29%) on a monster result. Everyone's screaming about it — which is exactly why you don't chase it now. It's the dish the whole room is Instagramming; the queue's out the door and the price is silly. Put your name down, wait for the hangover dip near $150, THEN eat. We check this one every single run as our 'how mad is the market' gauge.
catalysts: Monster earnings — best single day in over two years
Deutsche Bank flipped to Buy ($200 target)
The AI + defence software leader — structural demand
⚠️ BUT: already ripped +29% today, RSI 73 = overheated
picks.risk: Up 29% in ONE day and overbought (RSI 73). Classic 'chase it and get burned' setup. Wait for the dip — do not buy at $162.

runnerUp.name: Boeing
runnerUp.line: Rare 2-notch upgrade to Outperform ($300) — a defence/aero play you can actually get into now, no chasing.

picks.name: Eaton
picks.plain: The boring genius pick. Every AI data-centre needs power gear — Eaton sells the picks & shovels. Broker just upgraded to $502.
picks.chefTake: Everyone's betting on the flashy AI chip companies. Eaton quietly sells the power gear and wiring the whole circus plugs into — no data-centre runs without it. Boring? Yep. Boring makes money. A steady long-term serve while the flashier stuff gives you heartburn.
catalysts: Broker upgrade to 'Outperform' ($502 target)
Every AI data-centre needs Eaton's power gear
Clean uptrend — above both moving averages
26 analysts on the buy side
picks.risk: It's not cheap for an industrial. If the AI-spending mood sours, this de-rates along with the whole theme.
